title: Case: Armchair held at a pickup point after two logged attempts the recipient disputes
context: A boxed high-backed armchair for Yorick Blackwood, DL-5298, was diverted to a pickup point after Brackenford Arc logged two failed home delivery attempts.
initial_request: I have now waited in on two separate days for this chair and both times your driver says nobody answered when my camera shows no van on my road at all either day and then instead of anyone asking me you send it to a newsagent half a mile away and I rang on Thursday and explained I am disabled I use a wheelchair I cannot carry a chair that weighs more than my dog home from a shop and the man said someone would ring me back that day and nobody has and it is now Saturday and I am still sitting on a dining chair with a cushion on it and the shop says it goes back in a week so what exactly am I supposed to do

acceptable_actions.summary: Ask Ashgrove to order retrieval of DL-5298 from the pickup point and a home delivery booking, saying the depot ticket was auto-closed unactioned and why the recipient cannot collect.

must: Asks Ashgrove by Email to order retrieval of DL-5298 from Marrowby Lantern News and a new home delivery booking, as a request for Ashgrove to decide and confirm
Says the earlier depot ticket DQ-9026 was closed automatically with nothing done, and does not describe the request as already in hand

Tells Ashgrove the recipient is a wheelchair user who cannot collect a 23 kg carton, that she disputes both logged attempts on the strength of her door camera, and that the callback promised on the 11 May call was never made, so they can prioritise her
Mentions that the pickup point returns the parcel after 7 days
must_not: Tells the recipient the parcel is ready to collect, or suggests she send a friend, relative or neighbour to fetch it
Raises the request again with the Destination depot on the Depot work queue, or replies to the closed ticket
Tells the recipient a home delivery or a callback has been arranged, or gives her a date, before Ashgrove confirms one
States as fact that the driver never attempted, or that the attempts were falsely logged
Sends the recipient a stock apology for the missed deliveries that does not address the fact she cannot collect and was promised a call that never came
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: DL-5298, one carton, 23 kg, 110 cm, now at Marrowby Lantern News pickup point since 11 May. Please order a retrieval and a new home delivery booking. The recipient is a wheelchair user and cannot collect it; she told your agent this on the 11 May call (10:02) and was promised a callback from the depot the same day, which was not made and was never logged as a task. She also disputes both logged attempts (8 May 11:12, 10 May 12:47): she says she was in and her door camera shows no van at either time. I have not seen the footage and make no finding. My depot ticket DQ-9026 asking for this was auto-closed because the status reads 'Available for collection', so nothing has been actioned. The pickup point returns the parcel after 7 days. Please confirm what you can book and whether someone will contact her.
